title: 2-Digit Subtraction With Regrouping Worksheets
intro: Show your student that regrouping changes how a number is represented, not its value.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Use base-ten blocks to exchange one ten for ten ones. Record both changes before subtracting.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

42 = 4 tens + 2 ones
42 = 3 tens + 12 ones

Ask your student

Do we still have the same starting amount after the exchange?

If your student needs help

If the student adds ten ones without reducing the tens, compare the blocks with the written number.
